🤖 AI-based classification (Real vs Fake)
📊 Confidence score visualization
🔍 Grad-CAM heatmap for model explainability
⚡ Fast and efficient inference using MobileNetV2

projects.name: Gruntworkr
projects.description: GruntWorkr is a modern, AI-driven platform designed to streamline the recruitment process through in...
projects.longDescription: GruntWorkr is a modern, AI-driven platform designed to streamline the recruitment process through intelligent resume parsing, skill normalization, and candidate matching. Built with a multi-agent orchestration architecture, it leverages cutting-edge LLMs to provide precise talent insights.
features: Multi-Agent Parsing:** Specialized agents to extract personal info, experience, and education with high accuracy.
Intelligent Skill Mapping:** Automatically normalizes extracted skills against a central taxonomy.
Candidate-Job Matching:** Advanced matching algorithms to find the best fit for specific roles.
Real-time Telemetry:** Built-in tracking for performance monitoring and API health.
Modern Dashboard:** A sleek, responsive interface for managing the entire talent pipeline.

projects.longDescription: LegalAI is a premium, AI-powered platform designed to streamline legal document analysis. It helps users understand complex contracts by breaking them down into simpler terms, identifying risks, and providing multi-language explanations (English, Gujarati, and Hindi).
features: 📄 Smart PDF Parsing**: Upload legal documents and extract clauses automatically.
🔍 Clause Analysis**: AI-driven explanation of complex legal jargon in plain English.
🌍 Multi-language Support**: Explanations available in **English**, **Gujarati**, and **Hindi**.
⚠️ Risk Assessment**: Identifies potential risks (High, Medium, Low) in each clause.
📂 Categorization**: Automatically classifies clauses (e.g., Termination, Liability, Confidentiality).
